status: Curated research facts, not executable or certified scripts. See the companion spec for timing and variants.

preconditions: No graveyard replacement or entry prohibition
body: Sacrifice Miner to Altar for B
Target opponent with Rakdos trigger
Pass to Miner's crime trigger and pay B
Resolve Rakdos and return to priority
combos.payoff: Empty opponents' libraries; needs failed draws or a separate drain payoff to win
combos.bound: Arbitrarily many finite repeats; library output saturates

body: Sacrifice Miner for B
Target opponent with death drain, committing a crime
Pay B to return Miner
Resolve drain; after fourth resolution continue with emblem
breaks: Prevent life gain does not stop Altar version
combos.bound: Finite lethal; two phases, not one invariant across transformation

combos.resources: One seed B, life greater than desired count
body: Pay 1 life and sacrifice Miner
Target opponent with Rakdos
Pay seed B to return Miner before Treasure exists
Resolve Treasure ability and sacrifice Treasure for B
variants: Add Sephiroth for +1 life per death to offset cost and drain; Sephiroth can also replace Rakdos
Sephiroth alone is NOT a repeatable sacrifice outlet

combos.resources: No seed mana; Rakdos permission allows colorless for Thug's B
body: Sacrifice Thug for CC
Put Rakdos trigger below Thug trigger; target self and Thug respectively
Put Thug on library top
Exile top two with Rakdos
Cast Thug from exile using CC
combos.payoff: Add Blood Artist or Mayhem Devil for a kill, or Poxwalkers for mana and opponent exile
combos.bound: Can repeat after all other own library cards are exiled
variants: Poxwalkers returns on each exile cast; sacrifice it for net CC and Rakdos exile 3 from opponent
Blood Artist drains 1 per Thug death

pieces.filter: another targetable creature or artifact you control

preconditions: Duplication cast with seed target; retain priority to cast Mage
combos.resources: 1R plus 1RR bootstrap; no mana per copy
body: Resolve Mage; copy original Duplication
Retarget copy to Mage
Resolve token; its ETB copies original
Repeat, then target seed to stop
combos.payoff: Attack with hasty army or sacrifice for death/entry payoffs
breaks: Remove only Mage before a copy resolves
combos.bound: Arbitrary finite count; delayed sacrifices at next end step, NOT end of combat

preconditions: Saw on stack with seed target; Mage enters above it
body: Copy original Saw targeting Mage
Destroy Mage and create two smaller Mages
Use one ETB to continue copying original Saw
Use spare ETBs on a second spell or harmless seed target
combos.payoff: Arbitrary nonhasty 1/1 Mage tokens, or copies of a suitable other spell kept on stack
combos.bound: Arbitrary finite count; original 2/2 halves to 1/1, copies keep mana value 3

preconditions: Steady boundary: two Monk tokens battlefield, both instants hand
combos.resources: One B at steady-state boundary; bootstrap requires first Saw and Offering graveyard
body: Cast Offering for B sacrificing Monk A, produce five black mana
Cast Saw for 2B targeting Monk B
New Monks return Offering and Saw separately
combos.payoff: Arbitrary mana/storm; afterwards spend accumulated mana on repeated Saw to grow army, or use external payoff
combos.bound: Arbitrary finite repetitions; not net +1 Monk in the mana-building cycle

preconditions: Nightmare plus A battlefield; B graveyard
Mana and energy prefix budgets both feasible
combos.resources: Each round: two Nightmare casts cost 2BB, supply six energy; returned mana values must total at most six for indefinite repetition
body: Pay energy for B; sacrifice A and return Nightmare as costs
Resolve B and its entry/death mana
Recast Nightmare for 1B
Pay energy for A; sacrifice B and return Nightmare
Resolve A and recast Nightmare
combos.payoff: Rakdos library exile, Sephiroth drain, or positive mana for another outlet
combos.bound: Pair-specific, never assume all mana creatures work
variants: Priest of Gix + Priest of Urabrask: +2 mana, energy neutral
Priest of Gix + Charming Scoundrel: mana neutral, +1 energy
Priest of Gix + Cathodion: +2 mana, energy neutral
Atsushi + Charming Scoundrel: mana/energy neutral, Treasure modes
Atsushi + Priest of Gix: +2 mana but -1 energy each round, bounded without extra energy

preconditions: Breach and Altar battlefield, LED and Poxwalkers graveyard
combos.resources: No mana for LED escape; three other cards per escape
body: Escape LED, exiling three other graveyard cards
Return Poxwalkers on cast trigger
Resolve and sacrifice LED; discard hand and add three mana
Sacrifice Poxwalkers to Altar, mill self three
combos.payoff: Finite mana/storm and access to deck; add external win condition
variants: Cathodion instead: escape Cathodion for 3, mill it for three and regain CCC; mana neutral, needs seed CCC, no free spell needed for this subcycle
Rakdos is optional additional exile, not necessary; self-exile competes with future mill fuel

combos.resources: B seed if starting from graveyard; two life per warp cast
body: Sacrifice Culler for B
Resolve Rakdos exile two
Warp Culler from graveyard for B and two life before its delayed exile
combos.payoff: Bounded value chain, not an infinite by itself
combos.bound: Life bounded; Sephiroth only offsets one of two life per death
variants: Skittering Precursor added to Miner/Altar/Rakdos produces one Spawn each Miner sacrifice, enabling extra mana
Breach/LED/Poxwalkers plus Umbral Collar Zealot replaces absent Dementia with surveil one, but consumes net two graveyard fuel per iteration
Evoke creatures with Rakdos turn sacrifices into mana-value-sized library access; rituals and tutors make long, non-fixed storm chains
combos.test: Not simulated: additional research candidates, not certified macros
